attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_ecommerce_pipeline
steps:
  - id: search_product
    op: catalog/search
    params:
      query: "{{trigger.search_query}}"
      filters: "{{trigger.search_filters}}"
    output: search_results

  - id: authenticate_shopper
    op: auth/authenticate
    params:
      token: "{{trigger.auth_token}}"
      session_id: "{{trigger.session_id}}"
    output: shopper_identity

  - id: validate_cart
    op: schema/validate
    params:
      schema: checkout_schema
      data:
        shopper_id: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.user_id}}"
        cart_items: "{{trigger.cart_items}}"
        shipping_address: "{{trigger.shipping_address}}"
        payment_method: "{{trigger.payment_method}}"
    depends_on:
      - authenticate_shopper
    output: validated_cart

  - id: process_order
    op: order/process
    params:
      shopper_id: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.user_id}}"
      validated_cart: "{{validate_cart.validated_cart}}"
      payment_method: "{{trigger.payment_method}}"
    depends_on:
      - authenticate_shopper
      - validate_cart
    output: order_result

  - id: fulfill_order
    op: subworkflow/invoke
    params:
      workflow_id: fulfillment_subworkflow
      input:
        order_id: "{{process_order.order_result.order_id}}"
        items: "{{validate_cart.validated_cart.items}}"
        shipping_address: "{{trigger.shipping_address}}"
    depends_on:
      - process_order
    output: fulfillment_result

  - id: extract_fulfillment_status
    op: transform/extract
    params:
      source: "{{fulfill_order.fulfillment_result}}"
      fields:
        - status
        - tracking_number
        - estimated_delivery
    depends_on:
      - fulfill_order
    output: fulfillment_status

  - id: notify_customer
    op: notification/send
    params:
      recipient: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.email}}"
      template: order_fulfilled
      data:
        order_id: "{{process_order.order_result.order_id}}"
        status: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.status}}"
        tracking_number: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.tracking_number}}"
        estimated_delivery: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.estimated_delivery}}"
    depends_on:
      - extract_fulfillment_status
    output: notification_result

  - id: log_purchase_audit
    op: audit/log
    params:
      event_type: purchase_completed
      shopper_id: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.user_id}}"
      order_id: "{{process_order.order_result.order_id}}"
      fulfillment_status: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.status}}"
      notification_status: "{{notify_customer.notification_result.status}}"
      timestamp: "{{$now}}"
    depends_on:
      - notify_customer
    on_failure: retry
    always_run: true
    output: audit_log_entry
